source_crs: EPSG:2968, NAD83(HARN)/Indiana West (ftUS); elevations converted to meters
registration: Existing R5 GIS FID 642/local transform and manifest marker; X east, Y north, Z up.
height_sampling: Each existing top vertex retains its XY; z is set to a 3x3-cell median within the vertex's existing R5 NDHM band. Zones remain clipped to the existing GIS/shell-derived polygons. High zone cells above 22m are excluded from sampling because R5 found only two and cannot distinguish localized equipment from raster outliers.
uncertainty: 5-ft NDHM is a broad normalized surface; local cell variation can include roof equipment, vegetation, or classification noise. It does not identify exact roof planes, facade lines, trusses, overhangs, floors, or story count. Vertex heights form a generalized surface, not measured architectural slopes.

summary.method: 3x3 median of 5-ft NDHM cells in the same GIS-clipped height band; nearest five same-band cells used only when a vertex window has no valid sample.
